text.Conversion Yard:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, you may scrap a card in your hand and gain 4 Combat for it. Conversion Yard is an outpost with a defense of 4. 
 Strategy ==
Scrapping from hand is something that many players try to avoid, but this card is an exception to that rule as it gives 4 Combat for it. It is almost always a good deal to scrap a Scout or Viper for 4 Combat, and it may even be reasonable for some cheap cards, eventhough you don't get to play them anymore. Since it can unconditionally both scrap and boast 4 Combat, opponents often try to take it out first, which is not that hard since this Outpost only has a defense of 4.
